meta.name: Dev DD Season 2 720p
meta.description: In this modern-day take on Devdas, Devika is anything but your typical girl-next-door. With masaledaar drama, heartbreak, and unpredictable romantic twists, you’ve never met a girl like Devika DD! Will she ever find true love?

videos.title: Detox Devika
videos.overview: Devika is back to Jaipur after a breakup. Paritosh tries to console her. Anurag finds out that Aditi is pregnant.

videos.title: Ex-ccident
videos.overview: Anurag and Aditi arrive in Jaipur for an abortion. Paritosh takes Devika out on a date.

videos.title: Behen, Yeh Tera Baap Hai?
videos.overview: Anurag and Aditi are led back to the hospital for the abortion. Devika finds out that Anurag is Chandni’s father.

videos.title: Sab Khatam Aur Main Shuru
videos.overview: Devika is back to her former avatar. Devika hosts a party for the ladies of Jaipur.

videos.title: Kuch Toh Log Karengey
videos.overview: Radha also arrives in Jaipur to help Chandni. Devika and Radha help Chandni take her house back from her uncle.

videos.title: Pride Parade
videos.overview: Chandni apologizes to Devika for her rudeness. Devika’s attempt to find a job fails.

videos.title: Hook Up ya Fuck Up?
videos.overview: Chandni and Radha try to set up Devika with Paritosh. Anurag and Aditi find a lead to expose the malpractices at the hospital.

videos.title: Ex aur Next
videos.overview: Anurag and Aditi’s witness changes her mind at the last minute. Chandni is tricked into meeting a marriage prospect by her mother.

videos.title: To be or 32b
videos.overview: Chandni attempts suicide. Awasthi’s hacked phone leads Aditi and Anurag to a dead end.

videos.title: Nayi Date Purani Debate
videos.overview: Chandni recuperates, but feels dejected. Devika loses control of her emotions seeing Anurag at home.

videos.title: Sab Khatam. Almost
videos.overview: Devika’s is uncomfortable due to Anurag’s presence. Chandni and Radha’s wedding is announced.

videos.title: Bin Bulaya Boyfriend
videos.overview: Devika and Radha plan for a surprise proposal. Anurag helps set up the venue.

videos.title: Do You Want a Threesome?
videos.overview: Wedding celebrations begin, but alas, with some drama. Chandni tries to persuade Devika to give love another chance.

videos.title: Dulhans Ki Doli
videos.overview: Devika makes it clear that she has moved on from Anurag. Devika takes charge of the wedding destination.

videos.title: Ex Ki Gf ka New Friend, Mera Boyfriend
videos.overview: Chandni and Radha get married. Devika, Anurag, Aditi, and Paritosh investigate Meghna’s death.

videos.title: Sex, Boys And Heartbreak
videos.overview: Devika spirals out of control after Anurag’s death. Aditi finds evidences into Anurag’s death.

videos.title: Dev Dd 2.0 Hoon Main
videos.overview: Devika changes her wayward behaviour and moves on. The real culprit behind the female foeticide and gender determination is caught.
